violations.text: Chlorine sanitizer solution was observed in excess of 200 parts per million (ppm). A chlorine sanitizer solution applied to food contact surfaces must be between 50-100 ppm. Proper sanitizing procedures reviewed with staff at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/19/2026

Raw chicken was observed thawing near the 3-bay sink. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must be thawed in one of the following manners: under refrigeration (41 degrees Fahrenheit or less); completely submerged under running water; as part of the cooking process; or in the microwave if cooked immediately after thawing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/19/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine has an accumulation of black debris. New Violation. Correct By: 11/19/2026
